name: claude-mods
description: Two Claude Code mods: a usage meter for plan limits and a live pane of running agents

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with the 5-hour and weekly plan limits, context fill and estimated cost; toasts at 80% and 95%

plugins.name: swarm
plugins.description: A live pane of the agents running in the session: who spawned whom, status, tokens and estimated cost
